chapter_title: The Voice of Reason 5 (तर्क की आवाज़ 5)

acts.narrative_summary: Geralt studies Roderick de Novembre's history in the Melitele library. Mother Nenneke enters, exasperated and disgusted, announcing the arrival of Geralt's drunken, parasitic troubadour friend Dandilion.

acts.act_name: The Troubadour's Entrance & The Pinched Gatekeeper
acts.narrative_summary: Dandilion struts in wearing a lilac doublet with lace cuffs and sweeping feather hat, mock-bowing to Nenneke. Nenneke snaps at his bullshit and storms out. Dandilion admits he pinched the cute blonde gatekeeper's bottom.

Behind an arcane alchemy volume, Geralt unearths a straw-wrapped demijohn of potent plum vodka. Dandilion toasts enthusiastically to knowledge and inspiration, while Geralt coughs and nurses his bandaged throat.

acts.act_name: The Changing World & Absurd Monster Requests
acts.narrative_summary: Geralt explains why he must ride south: civilization has made witchers obsolete. Trolls are paid to repair bridges, barons protect pet dragons, and villagers demand nymphs or mecopteran bone powder to cure impotence.

acts.act_name: Unicorn Virgins & The Obsolescence of Witchers
acts.narrative_summary: Dandilion philosophizes on the decline of monster hunting, comparing witchers to unicorn virgins who popped their cherry when unicorns vanished, or ratcatchers ruined by poisons who took to drink and ruined their lives.

acts.act_name: Piss Beer, Unwashed Girls & Escape from Gulet
acts.narrative_summary: Geralt scoffs at the south's terrible food, bitter piss-like beer, unwashed girls, and mosquitoes. They fondly reminisce about their first journey together, fleeing Gulet after Dandilion knocked up a girl under the bandstand with four furious brothers threatening castration.
